Author, Humorist, Entrepreneur, Publisher, and Lecturer. Samuel Langhorne Clemens was born on November 30, 1835, in Florida, Missouri. When he was 4 years old, his family moved from Florida to nearby Hannibal on the Mississippi River where he grew up on the waterfront. His father, John Marshall Clemens, was an attorney...
